title: Giesekus Stick-Slip Singularity: Asymptotic Theory in the Log-Conformation Formulation
summary: In this paper, the log-conformation reformulation of a Giesekus fluid near a planar stick-slip singularity is investigated analytically. In what is, to our knowledge, the first use of the log-conformation formulation beyond its numerical purpose, we present results that match the asymptotic stress analysis of Evans [JNNFM 222 (2015) 24-33] for the stick, slip, and core regions under the assumption of a given Newtonian velocity field.
